remarks: TS Saudel (TC2621) is the only active system in the JMA feed. It is near the Truk Islands at 8.9N 153.2E and forecast to reach typhoon strength within 48h while tracking northwest. Closest approach to any tracked port over the full 120h forecast is about 1,385 km from Busan — nothing inside the 600 km threat radius, so no port is on watch.
Shanghai/Ningbo is the only disrupted port. Ten days after Typhoon Dolphin the anchorage queue is still growing rather than draining.

Busan and Qingdao have cleared. Busan's anchorage fell from 122 ships on 9 Aug to 28.5 on 16 Aug; Qingdao from 85.5 to 12. Kuehne+Nagel puts Busan's 7-day average wait at 1.38 days. Both are back to normal and are not listed.
MSC customer advisories carry no port-closure notices as of 19 Aug.
